resources.string: FileTuck
Save with FileTuck
FILETUCK / %1$s
A home for every\nshared file.
Share it. Tuck it away. Find it right where you want it.
SAVING TO
Download settings
Choose where new shared files are saved.
Downloads
Save directly to your Downloads folder.
Downloads / FileTuck
Keep files together. Created automatically on your first save.
Choose another folder
Pick an existing folder or create one in the folder picker.
How to save
1. Select one or more files in another app.\n2. Tap Share, then Save with FileTuck.\n3. Your files go to the folder selected above.
Changes apply to future saves. Existing files stay where they are.
